page.overview:
What is Jumbo Bricks?

Jumbo Bricks was a small theme exclusively manufactured by Samsonite from 1964 to 1972. The sets contained bricks larger than the normal system bricks much the same as today's DUPLO bricks. they were aimed at children from nursery school through to first grade. There were six sets produced for this theme.
